# AVENTA SHOP

> AVENTA SHOP is an online marketplace for electronics, fashion, grocery, beauty and home products, with flash sales, verified sellers and free delivery over $50.

AVENTA SHOP lets shoppers browse thousands of products across categories, compare items, follow flash sales and buy from approved sellers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured categories, flash sales, trending and recommended products.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalog with category, price and rating filters.
- [Flash Sales](/flash-sales): Limited-time deals and mega discounts.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side product comparison.
- [Help Center](/help-center): Shipping, returns, payments and support answers.

## Optional

- [Product pages](/product): Individual product detail pages with specs, pricing and customer reviews.
